shader_type canvas_item;
render_mode unshaded;

// Brightness and glyph density are independent. Flat midtones must not become a
// wall of equally bright letters. No TIME/random term: the grid stays screen-stable.
uniform sampler2D screen_texture : hint_screen_texture, repeat_disable, filter_linear;
uniform sampler2D glyph_atlas : repeat_disable, filter_nearest;
uniform float cell_px : hint_range(4.0, 12.0, 1.0) = 6.0;
uniform float exposure : hint_range(0.75, 1.75) = 1.08;
uniform float glyph_gain : hint_range(0.5, 2.5) = 1.40;
uniform float edge_gain : hint_range(0.0, 2.0) = 0.62;
uniform float bloom_strength : hint_range(0.0, 0.7) = 0.16;
uniform float readability : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.72;
uniform float background_calm : hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.68;
uniform float color_saturation : hint_range(0.35, 1.0) = 0.78;
const float GLYPH_COUNT = 32.0;

float luma(vec3 value) {
    return dot(value, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
}

void fragment() {
    vec2 cell = vec2(floor(cell_px + 0.5), floor(cell_px * 1.5 + 0.5));
    vec2 grid = SCREEN_UV / (SCREEN_PIXEL_SIZE * cell);
    vec2 local_uv = fract(grid);
    vec2 center = (floor(grid) + 0.5) * SCREEN_PIXEL_SIZE * cell;
    vec2 dx = vec2(SCREEN_PIXEL_SIZE.x * cell.x * 0.30, 0.0);
    vec2 dy = vec2(0.0, SCREEN_PIXEL_SIZE.y * cell.y * 0.30);
    vec3 central = texture(screen_texture, center).rgb;
    vec3 left = texture(screen_texture, center - dx).rgb;
    vec3 right = texture(screen_texture, center + dx).rgb;
    vec3 up = texture(screen_texture, center - dy).rgb;
    vec3 down = texture(screen_texture, center + dy).rgb;
    vec3 average = (central * 4.0 + left + right + up + down) / 8.0;
    vec3 peak = max(central, max(max(left, right), max(up, down)));
    // Thin beams survive sampling, without making every cell a peak-brightness cell.
    vec3 src = mix(average, peak, 0.12) * exposure;
    src = src / (1.0 + max(src - 0.80, vec3(0.0)) * 0.55);
    float raw_luma = luma(src);
    float contrast = abs(luma(right) - luma(left)) + abs(luma(down) - luma(up));
    float local_shape = smoothstep(0.025, 0.22, contrast);
    float highlight = smoothstep(0.52, 0.86, max(src.r, max(src.g, src.b)));
    float importance = max(local_shape, highlight);
    float surface = smoothstep(0.014, 0.075, raw_luma);
    float lifted = pow(clamp(raw_luma, 0.0, 1.0), mix(0.97, 0.69, readability));
    lifted = clamp(lifted + local_shape * edge_gain * 0.085, 0.0, 1.0);

    // Calm flat walls/floor; keep light sources and shape boundaries detailed.
    float calm = background_calm * (1.0 - importance);
    float coverage = lifted * mix(1.0, 0.43, calm);
    coverage = max(coverage, surface * (0.025 + readability * 0.04));
    float glyph_index = floor(clamp(coverage, 0.0, 0.9999) * GLYPH_COUNT);
    vec2 atlas_uv = vec2((glyph_index + local_uv.x) / GLYPH_COUNT, local_uv.y);
    float glyph = texture(glyph_atlas, atlas_uv).r;

    // Retain the source color ratio rather than clipping each channel to a floor;
    // per-channel floors used to tint every very dark surface equally.
    vec3 normalized_hue = src / max(raw_luma, 0.025);
    vec3 hue = mix(vec3(1.0), min(normalized_hue, vec3(2.0)), color_saturation);
    float ink_value = max(lifted, surface * (0.11 + readability * 0.13));
    ink_value *= mix(1.0, 0.76, calm);
    vec3 ink = hue * ink_value * clamp(glyph_gain * 0.76, 0.55, 1.50);
    // Only a dark cell bed, not a conventional-3D bypass for the environment.
    vec3 background = src * mix(0.045, 0.085, readability);
    vec3 result = mix(background, ink, glyph);
    result += max(average - vec3(0.75), vec3(0.0)) * bloom_strength * 0.20;
    COLOR = vec4(clamp(result, vec3(0.0), vec3(1.0)), 1.0);
}
